Name: Better Artisan Good Icons for Joja Fairy Rose
Author: waterscapes
Description:
I made this mod so that I could use it in conjunction with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12279]BAGI for Joja Seeds[/url] mod. The cap for the honey is blue to match! 

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/58746061]PurpleChickadee[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url] for giving me permission to use their assets and make this mod!

How to Install:
1. Extract "[BAGI] Joja Fairy Rose" into your Mods folder.

How to Uninstall:
1. Delete "[BAGI] Joja Fairy Rose" from your Mods folder.
